description: Use this when you want to find a trader by X handle or display name; returns up to 50 matches with handle, name, score, rank, trade count and qualified status. Paid with x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base; call without payment first to get the requirements). For the full ranking use trader_get_leaderboard.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.
limit.title: Limit

payment.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment signature. Leave empty on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements, then call again with the signed payment.
payment.title: Payment

query.description: Text to match against trader handles and display names. Maximum 100 characters; letters, digits, @, - and spaces are used, other characters are dropped.
query.title: Query

name: trader_search_trader
